ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state organic structure, with a benzene ring fused to a nitrogen-containing six-membered ring on the left; the nitrogen-containing six-membered ring has an N-H and is connected to a phenyl group on the right. The central carbon above the ring is connected to two substituents, H2O+ and CO2H. Curved arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring arrows; hydrogen-containing bonds are not counted in the total. Reasoning count: Count non-hydrogen bonds by fragments. The left fused benzene ring counts as 6 C-C bonds. There are 5 additional bonds that complete the fused nitrogen-containing six-membered ring and do not double-count the edge shared with the benzene ring. The right phenyl ring has 6 C-C bonds, and there is 1 connecting single bond between this phenyl group and the heterocycle. The top substituents include: 1 bond from the central carbon to H2O+, 1 bond from the central carbon to the carboxyl carbon, and 2 non-hydrogen bonds inside CO2H. The total is 6 + 5 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 22.

method.method_draft: Count non-H bonds fragment by fragment. First count the left fused benzene ring as 6 C-C bonds. Add the five additional bonds that complete the fused N-containing ring beyond the shared benzene edge. Add the right phenyl ring as 6 C-C bonds and its single attachment bond to the heterocycle. Add the top substituents: the bond from the central carbon to H2O+, the bond from the central carbon to the carboxyl carbon, and the two non-H bonds inside CO2H. Sum these counts to obtain 22.

method.method_draft: Build an adjacency list of all non-H connections from the picture. Around the fused left benzene/heterocycle system, record each unique C-C or C-N edge once, treating the shared fused edge as only one edge. Then record the two edges from the top stereocenter/substitution center to the oxonium oxygen and to the carboxyl carbon. Expand CO2H into the carboxyl C=O and C-O edges, excluding O-H. Finally record the right phenyl ring's six internal C-C edges plus the single bond connecting it to the heterocyclic carbon. Count the unique adjacencies in the list; the total is 22.

推理计数：按非氢原子之间的唯一连接来数键。左侧稠合苯环/含氮杂环系统中，苯环 6 条内部 C-C 键，加上杂环 6 条环内 C-C/C-N 键，但两环共享的稠合边只算一次，因此为 6 + 6 - 1 = 11 条。顶部取代中心到 oxonium 氧、到羧基碳各 1 条，共 2 条。CO2H 中羧基 C=O 和 C-O 各 1 条，O-H 不计，共 2 条。右侧苯环有 6 条内部 C-C 键，另有 1 条键将该苯环连接到杂环碳。总数为 11 + 2 + 2 + 6 + 1 = 22。
